user.title: Connect to Westerville Utilities
user.description: Enter the username and password you use to log in at billpay.westerville.org.

reauth_confirm.title: [%key:common::config_flow::title::reauth%]
reauth_confirm.description: The Westerville portal rejected the stored password for {username}. Enter the current password to reconnect.

init.title: Westerville Utilities options
init.description: Changing these reloads the integration and applies immediately.

data_description.update_interval_hours: How often to sync with the portal. Westerville's own data lags 1-2 days behind real time, so shorter intervals just re-request the same numbers.
data_description.backfill_daily_days: How far back to import daily usage on first sync. The portal typically retains ~9 months of daily data; going further back just costs extra requests for no data.
data_description.backfill_hourly_days: How far back to import hourly usage on first sync. The portal typically retains ~2 weeks of hourly data.
